name: Pumpkin and Chickpea Curry

ingredients.name: jap pumpkin
ingredients.original: 1 kg jap pumpkin, peeled and cut into 3 cm pieces

ingredients.name: chickpeas
ingredients.original: 400 g tin chickpeas, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the onion over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, curry powder and turmeric and stir for a minute, until the spices smell toasted.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes, until the mixture darkens and thickens, then pour in the coconut milk.
Add the pumpkin, bring to a simmer and cook covered for 20 minutes, until a knife slides into the pumpkin with no resistance.
Stir in the chickpeas and cook uncovered for another 5 minutes to thicken. Meanwhile cook the rice by the absorption method.
Fold the spinach through until it wilts, season, and serve over the rice scattered with coriander.
